title: Exact Radial Excursion Thresholds, p-Band Tower Conservation, the Unconditional Las Vegas Omega(N log log log N) Octave-Decision Barrier, and 172-Order-of-Magnitude Outer Threshold Sharpening for Almost-Linear Single-Source Shortest Paths
abstract: Following Iman Gholami and MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi's breakthrough O(m + n log log log n) randomized comparison-addition algorithm for undirected real-weighted single-source shortest paths (arXiv:2611.34911v1), we establish four exact structural, lower-bound, and non-asymptotic threshold results backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 certificates, and 56 adversarial tests: (1) Exact generalized radial excursion threshold and tightness: combining both flanks of a radial geodesic peak under detour ratio d_e <= alpha * w_e yields the two-sided lower bound L >= (2M - J_x - J_y)/(1 + alpha), proving the exact critical shell ratio K_crit(alpha) = 2/(1 - alpha) with a tight 3-vertex witness at equality; at alpha = 1/2, K_crit(1/2) = 4, minimal integer K = 5, and minimal power-of-two K = 8 (halving Lemma 8.1's K = 16, reducing Lemma 8.2's bottleneck constant 4K^2 h by 4x and K^4 by 16x); (2) p-band disjoint-set and multi-pass MST tower conservation: extending Lemma 3.6 to arbitrary fixed p >= 1 rank bands yields W_p(k, Q) <= pQ + k(b_1 + p - 1) = O(pQ + k log^(p) k), proving that disjoint-set and MST subroutines push strictly below log log log k (e.g., p = 4 achieves O(Q + k log^(4) k)); (3) Unconditional Las Vegas Omega(N log log log N) octave-decision barrier: combining exact binary-tree external path length epl(T) >= (k+2)L - 2^(k+1), dyadic midpoint injectivity (L >= M^N), and Yao's minimax principle proves that every Las Vegas linear comparison-addition algorithm classifying N real weights into M = Theta(log log N) dyadic octaves requires at least N * floor(log_2 M) = Omega(N log log log N) expected comparisons; and (4) Moore 2-core peeling halving and 172-order outer threshold sharpening: halving Lemma 6.2's critical-edge witness path length from 4*ceil(log_2(t+2))+3 to 2r (girth > 2r+1, 3*2^r - 2 > t) while tightening |E| <= 2t - 3, and certifying inside Lean 4 that Algorithm 8's N > L_N^64 guard activates only at N_0(64) = 589^64 + 1 (~1.938e177), whereas b = L_N^4 already absorbs t*log^4(t+2) = O(N) and drops the exact crossover >172 orders of magnitude to N_0(4) = 17^4 + 1 = 83,522 (and local 2*L_N^4 to 209,953).
